description: This Java source file defines the AssetProvider class, a ContentProvider implementation that serves files from the application's assets directory. It primarily supports opening asset files based on URI path segments and contains stub implementations for other ContentProvider methods.

classes.name: AssetProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider subclass that serves files from the app's assets directory, mainly implementing the openAssetFile method.

methods.name: openAssetFile
methods.description: Opens an asset file specified by the URI's last path segment. Throws FileNotFoundException if the asset name is invalid or cannot be found.
